verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a hosted scraping service, so data residency and region selection is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no region or residency option: the IP allowlists, key restrictions, URL blocking, and audit streams it does document are adjacent security controls. Its open-source, self-hostable availability is at most a user-side workaround, not a documented residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
